tests.name: admin status reports registration open on a fresh install
tests.detail: registration open, no administrator yet

tests.name: weak credentials are rejected
tests.detail: password < 8 chars, username < 3 chars and empty body all rejected with 400

tests.name: first valid registration succeeds and sets an HttpOnly session cookie
tests.detail: registered "chiefengineer", 64-char token, HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax

tests.name: password is stored as a salted scrypt hash, never in clear text
tests.detail: scrypt (N=16384, 64-byte key) with a 32-char random salt

tests.name: registration is permanently disabled once an administrator exists
tests.detail: second registration rejected with HTTP 403 — one-time registration enforced

tests.name: every privileged admin endpoint rejects anonymous callers
tests.detail: 5 privileged endpoints all return 401 without a session

tests.name: forged and tampered session cookies are rejected
tests.detail: 4 forged cookies rejected with 401

tests.name: login rejects a wrong password and accepts the right one
tests.detail: wrong password and unknown user → 401, valid credentials → 200 + HttpOnly cookie

tests.name: repeated failed sign-ins are rate limited
a forged X-Forwarded-For cannot poison the visitor log
tests.detail: 1 visitor(s), all from the real socket address

tests.name: authenticated visitor list exposes WAN IP and geolocation fields
tests.detail: 2 visitor(s); sample 127.0.0.1 → Local network, RFC1918

tests.name: logout invalidates the session
tests.detail: session destroyed on logout, subsequent calls rejected

tests.name: /admin page is served with cache and indexing protections
tests.detail: Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private · X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive

tests.name: robots.txt disallows /admin and /api/
tests.detail: User-agent: * · Disallow: /admin · Disallow: /api/ ·

tests.name: the admin console is not discoverable from the public site
tests.detail: no link, script reference or menu entry to the console anywhere in the public UI

tests.name: path traversal cannot read files outside public/
tests.detail: 7 traversal payloads blocked

tests.name: the update endpoint cannot be driven with injected shell input
tests.detail: fixed script path, no user data in spawn(), unauthenticated call rejected (401)

tests.name: cross-origin WebSocket connections are refused
tests.detail: hostile origin rejected · same origin open · no origin open

tests.name: baseline security headers are present
tests.detail: nosniff · CSP on the HMI · X-Frame-Options: DENY + frame-ancestors on /admin

tests.name: no reflected XSS: API responses are JSON with a safe content type
tests.detail: JSON API only; 404 handler is plain text and escapes nothing dangerous

tests.name: JSON body parser is size limited and rejects malformed JSON
tests.detail: malformed JSON → HTTP 400, server still serving

tests.name: no credentials or tokens are committed to the repository
tests.detail: 57 tracked files and the full history scanned — no secrets

tests.name: runtime data (admin credentials, sessions) is excluded from git
tests.detail: data/, node_modules/, .env and logs/ are all ignored

tests.name: npm dependency audit (express, ws)
tests.detail: advisories — critical 0, high 0, moderate 0, low 0

tests.name: no dangerous patterns in the server source
tests.detail: 5 server-side files free of eval/Function/command interpolation

tests.name: the systemd unit grants only the minimum sudo rights
tests.detail: installer writes three narrowly scoped NOPASSWD systemctl rules (restart/start/stop, this unit only); not installed in this test sandbox

tests.name: Control API is unauthenticated by design
tests.detail: POST /api/command, /api/fault/inject and the WebSocket command channel let any client that can reach the port start, trip and fault the unit — that is what makes the HMI work without a login. Deploy behind a firewall/VPN or put a reverse proxy with HTTP auth in front of it if the port is exposed.

tests.name: Session cookie is issued without the Secure flag
tests.detail: The admin cookie carries HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax but not Secure, because the installer defaults to plain HTTP. Terminate TLS in front of the app (nginx + Let's Encrypt) and the cookie should be upgraded to Secure + __Host- prefix.
